name: cover_letter_gen_v1
description: Generate a tailored cover letter for a job application. Takes the job description, candidate background, and key projects to highlight. Returns a professional cover letter in English or Korean.

job_description.description: Full job description or key requirements

candidate_summary.description: Brief summary of the candidate's background, skills, and experience

key_projects.description: List of project names or descriptions to highlight in the cover letter
